fact: At the 26 November 2025 PNER financing round table, presented data put rural electricity access at 25.7% (national 51.1%), and the AGER director general said 23% of rural people have access against 91% of urban.
title: Électrification rurale : un plan à 3,6 milliards de dollars pour sortir la Guinée du noir d’ici 2040
